data.description: Follow-up from hive-flow-9331 Slice B. Gemini/agy restricted modes now drop --dangerously-skip-permissions and add --sandbox, but the live canary was deferred because agy headless Google sign-in is currently unavailable from detached workers. Once auth is restored, run a live read-only/read-only-with-artifacts confinement canary with filesystem checks for root, sibling, artifact, and no-bypass behavior; route any regression as a fix slice.
